content: National Cancer Institute (NCI) : We extracted free text from 116 articles on various cancer types (729 QA pairs). We manually restructured the content of the articles to generate complete answers (e.g. a full answer about the treatment of all stages of a specific type of cancer). Figure FIGREF54 presents examples of QA pairs generated from a NCI article.
